name: Prestige Premium Loro Parque African Parakeet Mix

variants.name: 1 kg
variants.about_this_item:
• Enriched seed mixture with extruded VAM pellets for African parakeets such as lovebirds and parrotlets
  • Vitamins, amino acids and minerals for optimal condition
  • Composed in consultation with the scientific team of Loro Parque (Tenerife)
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: yellow millet, peeled oats, white millet, canary seed, VAM pellets, paddy rice, Japanese millet, safflower, buckwheat, oats, linseed, oyster shells.

Analytical constituents: protein 12.5%, fat content 7%, crude fibre 8%, crude ash 6%, calcium 0.9%, phosphorus 0.4%, lysine 0.35%, methionine 0.30%, threonine 0.40%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 8800 IU, vitamin D3 1600 IU, vitamin E 20 mg, iron 20 mg, iodine 1.5 mg, copper 7 mg, manganese 48 mg, zinc 45 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Provide freely and refresh regularly. Always supply fresh drinking water. Avoid simultaneous oral use with macrolides.
